title: Collective Collaboration of Recursive Autonomous Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.33515v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Smart factories must translate order-level objectives into production tasks at multiple scales and combine the capabilities of individual units into an overall delivery capability. To address repeated adaptation of organizational mechanisms across equipment, workshops, and factories, as well as coordination across levels under changing production conditions, this paper develops a framework for the collective collaboration of recursive autonomous agents (RAAs). A common task and capability interface supports the recursive decomposition of production objectives from the top down and the aggregation of conditional capabilities through peer collaboration from the bottom up. Composite units can therefore participate in higher-level organizations as agents of the same kind. We formulate organizational models for leaf and composite units, specify interface closure under composition and conditions for finite task expansion, and develop operation

translated_title: 递归自主智能体的集体协作
translated_abstract: 智慧工厂需要将订单级目标转化为多尺度的生产任务，并将各个单元的能力整合为整体交付能力。为了解决跨设备、车间和工厂的组织机制反复调整问题，以及生产条件变化下的跨层级协调问题，本文提出了一个递归自主智能体（RAA）集体协作框架。统一的任务与能力接口支持自上而下地对生产目标进行递归分解，以及通过同级协作自下而上地对条件能力进行聚合。因此，复合单元可以作为同类智能体参与更高层级的组织。本文为叶子单元和复合单元建立了组织模型，明确了组合下的接口封闭性以及有限任务扩展的条件，并开发了运行机制。
tldr: 该论文提出了递归自主智能体（RAA）的集体协作框架，通过统一的任务与能力接口，实现生产目标自上而下的递归分解和条件能力自下而上的聚合，使复合单元可作为同类智能体参与更高层级组织，从而解决智慧工厂中多尺度任务转化与跨层级动态协调的难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a collective collaboration framework for recursive autonomous agents (RAAs), which enables top-down recursive decomposition of production objectives and bottom-up aggregation of conditional capabilities through a common task and capability interface, allowing composite units to participate in higher-level organizations as same-kind agents to address multi-scale task translation and cross-level coordination challenges in smart factories.
